t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The brown, purple, pink, and yellow gnomes tend to give higher amounts of mushrooms, though this can vary.

vb_textbox.text: Firstly, you're going to want to gauge the amount of mushrooms each coloured gnome tends to take you to. The gnomes always come in the following pairs:pink | greenpurple | blueyellow | redorange | brownFor each pair, one will always take you to significantly more than the other, so figure out which is which (being sure to divide by the multiplier) early on and memorise it. Then just keep picking from the higher scoring choice of colour.A few things to bear in mind:- The better choice can change occasionally, seemingly at random, so if your strategy stops working, immediately switch to the other gnome.- When this flip happens, it affects *all* of the gnomes, so for example if orange and yellow were working, but then brown started being the better choice, you should switch from yellow to red too.
